name: regency
description: The Regent's harness, built on Claude Code. AA works as a PO/DV/QA/DA team; the Regent decides at the review packet. The rules travel as files and scripts: five inference engines, Orders and speed modes, a health checkup, code-to-norm lineage with a shortcuts index, guard hooks with the Regent's grants, a version gate with updates, auto-mode and headless profiles, and domain packs that adopt any Claude Code plugin per project. The practical part of Hackiavelli, The Manual of Good Regency.
